posts.title: What Is It Like to Live Aboard a Yacht in Fort Lauderdale?
posts.description: Discover what liveaboard life really feels like in Fort Lauderdale — from daily routines and marina costs to the freedom of waking up on the water.
posts.heroAlt: A woman in her early forties sitting on the stern deck of a sailing yacht at a Fort Lauderdale marina, reading a book in warm morning light, candid and relaxed
